description: An infection affecting the skin between the toes, which may be fungal, bacterial, or mixed.
causes: Fungal infection, bacterial overgrowth, or mixed infection

appearance.general: Macerated, peeling, cracked, or inflamed skin between the toes.

warning_signs: Spreading redness, severe pain, pus, fever, or tissue breakdown requires assessment.
prevention: Keep spaces between the toes clean and dry.
Use breathable footwear and change damp socks regularly.
